name: crumb
description: Your household's recipes, meal plan, shopping list and kitchen, so ChatGPT can plan meals from what you have and the diets people share, and add them to your plan and shopping list.

interface.longDescription: Your household's recipes, meal plan, shopping list and kitchen, so ChatGPT can plan meals from what you have and the diets people share, and add them to your plan and shopping list. With writes on, it adds list items, empty-slot dinners, event lists and new recipes, and can take a dish off the plan, an item out of the Kitchen or an item off a shopping list after checking with you in the chat. It never deletes recipes, lists, people or households.
defaultPrompt: Add milk to my shopping list

positive.description: Suggests dinner from what's in the Kitchen and the diets people share
positive.prompt: What can I cook tonight from Schnitzel’s Kitchen?
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the Kitchen, people and diets, then suggests recipes from the household's library that suit everyone eating and use what is on hand. Changes nothing.

positive.description: Finds a recipe and shows its method
positive.prompt: Find a vegetarian recipe in Schnitzel’s Kitchen and show me the method.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds a vegetarian recipe in the household's library and shows its ingredients and method. Changes nothing.

positive.description: Adds items to the shopping list
positive.prompt: Add milk and eggs to my Schnitzel’s Kitchen shopping list.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds milk and eggs to the default shopping list and says which list. The app shows the batch with Undo all.

positive.description: Plans a dinner on an empty night
positive.prompt: Plan dinner for tomorrow in Schnitzel’s Kitchen using a recipe I already have.
positive.expected_behavior: Picks a recipe from the library that suits the people eating and adds it to tomorrow's empty dinner slot. Never replaces a planned dish.

positive.description: Saves a recipe the user describes
positive.prompt: Save this to Schnitzel’s Kitchen: Lemon pasta. 200 g spaghetti, 1 lemon, 30 g parmesan. Boil pasta, toss with lemon zest, juice and parmesan.
positive.expected_behavior: Saves a new recipe called Lemon pasta with those ingredients and steps, and says it was saved.

negative.description: Unrelated request: should not call Schnitzel’s Kitchen
Delete request: Schnitzel’s Kitchen never deletes recipes, so it should explain it can't
negative.prompt: Delete all my recipes in Schnitzel’s Kitchen.

negative.description: Someone else's household: should say it can only see the signed-in household
negative.prompt: Show me my neighbour's shopping list in Schnitzel’s Kitchen.

publication.release_notes: Renamed from Crumb to Schnitzel's Kitchen, with the new logo. The description now covers taking a dish off the plan, an item out of the Kitchen or an item off a shopping list after checking in the chat.
